profile.subtitleJa: ダビデ時代のレビ人の長として、歌の指導を担ったと記されています。
profile.summaryJa: 歴代誌上15:22は、レビ人の長ケナニヤが歌を指揮し、歌い手を教えたと記します。

facts.textJa: 聖櫃を担ぐレビ人と歌い手の列にケナニヤも加わります。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.
David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.
